Name: Living Portrait
Author: Batimaax
Description:
[size=5]Living Portrait[/size]

Give your farmer a [b]personalised portrait in the dialogue box[/b]  that reacts to your world: [b]season, weather, time of day, festivals, where you are, whether you're indoors or in your pyjamas, and your emotion[/b]. It can also draw a [b]dynamic background[/b] that changes with the weather and time, a context-aware [b]decorative ornament[/b], and a personalised [b]name banner[/b]. Everything is optional and configurable in-game.

It's a Content Patcher pack (JSON + art, no code of its own), it feeds custom art to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]Farmer Portraits[/url] framework, which renders the portrait. This download also bundles [b]Frame Fit[/b], a small mod companion that scales the dialogue portraits to fill the wooden frame, removing the empty gap below them.

[size=4]⚠ Beta with placeholder art[/size]
This early release ships the [b]complete, working reaction system[/b] with [b]placeholder art[/b]: the farmer busts are solid, labelled colour blocks, and the dynamic backgrounds and name banners are simple placeholder graphics, so you can see every reaction and every mode working before adding your own art, or using assets from other mods. I am waiting for permission to publish the mod with art from other mods, and currently working on creating portraits for every scenario.
It's released early so the system can be tested in the wild, soooo feedback is very welcome.

[size=4]Main features[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Reactive portrait: [/b]your farmer's bust changes with season, weather, time of day, festivals, location, indoor/pyjama state, and emotion, via a fallback system. You can also use the live portrait from Farmer Portrait.[/*]
[*][b]Three background modes[/b]: [b]Default[/b] (vanilla wooden frame), [b]Dynamic[/b] (full-bleed sky that changes with weather and time), [b]Dynamic Framed[/b] (dynamic sky drawn inside the vanilla wooden frame).[/*]
[*][b]Context-aware ornaments:[/b] finished decorative overlays that follow the season, location, crops, and festivals.[/*]
[*][b]Personalised name banner:[/b] an optional name plate that adapts to context.[/*]
[*][b]Fully GMCM-configurable: [/b]master switch, emotions, weather tier, festivals, background modes, indoor overlay, banner, and per-context ornament toggles. Every feature is optional and degrades gracefully.[/*]
[*][b]Frame Fit companion:[/b] scales the NPC and farmer dialogue portraits to fill the wooden frame (independent scale/offset for each, tunable in GMCM). You can even use the Fit mod with other portrait mod with which you experience the infamous gap issue.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]Farmer Portraits[/url] (and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for the settings UI.[/*]
[*]Download [b]Living Portrait [/b]and unzip it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder. You'll get a [i]Living Portrait[/i] folder containing the content pack and the optional [i]Frame Fit[/i] add-on. SMAPI loads both. (Delete the Frame Fit folder if you don't want it.)[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI once to generate the config.[/*]
[*]In [b]Farmer Portraits' own settings[/b]: keep [b]Use Custom Portrait[/b] ON (or the art is ignored), and turn [b]Portrait Reactions[/b] ON if you want the emotion busts. It's OFF by default in Farmer Portraits, so the emotions do nothing until you enable it there.[/*]
[/list]                                                                               
[size=4]Requirements[/size]                                                           
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+ (Stardew Valley 1.6+): required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.0+: required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]Farmer Portraits[/url]: required (renders the portrait)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]: recommended (in-game settings UI)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]: optional (only for the special-event ornaments)                                            [/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
Living Portrait owns the farmer portrait asset and the vanilla portrait-frame region, so [b]disable these if you run them[/b]:
[list]
[*]Other packs that replace the farmer portrait (Farmer Portrait, Seasonal Farmer Portraits, Farmer Emotion, …).[/*]
[*]Standalone Portrait Frame Variations, and any "Farmer Portraits background" option in another pack. The latter stops Farmer Portraits from sampling the live region and freezes the dynamic background.[/*]
[/list]Because the dynamic background edits the shared portrait-frame texture, the NPC's (and shopkeeper's) portrait background is themed too.

[size=4]Multiplayer[/size]
Each player runs Farmer Portraits + this pack locally and sees their own farmer's portrait. The pack holds one art set, so each person installs their own.

[b][size=4]Working on:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Generate all generic farmer portraits to replace the placeholders (maybe at some point a farmer portrait generation app)[/*]
[*]Add the background assets for dynamic and framed dynamic backgrounds (waiting for original author's authorization)[/*]
[*]Draw the custom banner assets and replace the banner place holders[/*]
[*]Unify the C# LivingPortraitFrameFit and Living Portrait in one mod[/*]
[*]New feature: possibility to modify the whole discussion frame and discussion background. [/*]
[*]Create backgrounds for the special weather events from Weather Wonders mod (not a priority tbh) [/*]
[/list][left][b]If you are an artist and want to help, let me know![/b][/left]
[left][b]

Their art is not included in this release, placeholder skies are used while permission to bundle it is arranged.[/*]

Manifest.Name: Living Portrait
Manifest.Description: Personalised farmer portrait in the dialogue box (via Farmer Portraits), reacting to season, weather, time, festival, location, indoor/pajama state and emotion, with an optional dynamic weather/time background, decorative ornament and name banner. Bundles the Frame Fit companion that scales the dialogue portraits to fill the wooden frame. Fully GMCM-configurable, all optional with graceful fallback. Beta: bust and background art are placeholders until the pixel-art phase.
Manifest.Author: Batimax

Manifest.Name: Living Portrait Frame Fit
Manifest.Description: Scales the dialogue portraits to fill the wooden frame, removing the gap below them. The NPC portrait works standalone (no other mod needed); the farmer portrait needs Farmer Portraits with 'Use Custom Portrait' on. Built for Living Portrait's Dynamic Framed mode but works with or without it. GMCM-tunable.
Manifest.Author: Batimax
